name: agilex_benchmark_data
description: Agilex_benchmark_data is a Hugging Face dataset intended to support benchmarking of model behavior across a collection of evaluation instances. It aggregates task examples used by the dataset author for evaluating model responses, potentially covering reasoning, QA, and behavioral tests. Metadata and task composition vary by release and should be inspected on the dataset page for details.
reputation: Community/curation-level dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited broader academic citation to date.
